messages:
Noah (AE): Heads-up: UK-based payments POC wants our incident disclosure cadence + a short POC clause. Can we give them an outbound template and CAIQ snippets?
Priya (Security): We typically do internal detection/ack within 4h, substantive update by 24h, customer notification within 72h of confirmed impact. For POCs we can stick to that but note hosted vs VPC differences.
Abe (Legal): Agree on 4/24/72 as a customer-facing cadence. Add carve-outs: law enforcement restrictions and region-specific regulator windows (FCA, ICO). Ill draft a tight clause.
Hana (Solutions): Important: for Hosted POC we own ops and notification; for VPC were advisory unless contracted otherwise. I'll draft a one-line SOW addendum that the customer checks.
Noah (AE): Customer asked: "Will Redwood provide live incident updates or just periodic emails?"
Priya (Security): Offer a communications plan: initial ack + hourly slack/bridge updates for the first 8h for high-severity, then 24h cadence. Keep live bridge as an option.
Abe (Legal): Sample contract text (paste):
```
Incident Notification. Redwood will: (i) acknowledge a reported or detected security event affecting Customer within four (4) hours; (ii) provide an initial substantive update within twenty-four (24) hours describing known scope and containment measures; and (iii) notify Customer of confirmed Customer data disclosure within seventy-two (72) hours of confirmation. Detailed forensic reports will be made available under an appropriate confidentiality arrangement. To the extent applicable law requires different timelines, Redwood will comply and notify Customer as permitted.
```
Priya (Security): Add POC note: "For Proof-of-Concept engagements, remedial responsibility depends on deployment model. Redwood will provide recommended mitigations and operational support per the SOW."
Hana (Solutions): Proposed POC comms cadence to share with customer: 
```
T+0: detection + 4h ack
T+8: high-severity bridge (if needed)
T+24: substantive update (scope, likely vectors)
T+48: mitigation status
T+72: confirmed impact & remediation plan (if confirmed)
```
Noah (AE): They also want a one-page sample notification they can use for regulators/counsel. Can we give a neutral template?
Abe (Legal): Sample text (can be edited): 
"We identified activity affecting systems used in our POC with Redwood Inference. Redwood is supporting our investigation. We have an acknowledgement timeline and will provide updates per our incident communications plan. We will share confirmed scope and remediation steps within 72 hours of confirmation. Detailed forensics will be provided under confidentiality as required."
Priya (Security): Note on model leakage vs customer data: treat model-output leaks as operational incidents; escalate to customer notify if outputs contain customer secrets or PII. Controller obligations generally apply to data breaches.
Noah (AE): Customer jurisdiction: UK + US. Will need FCA/ICO considerations for personal data.
Hana (Solutions): I'll add a checkbox in the SOW addendum for Deployment Mode (Hosted / Dedicated / VPC) and a short paragraph per option explaining notification responsibilities.
Abe (Legal): Next steps: Ill put clause + sample notification in a doc. Priya, attach CAIQ/SIG rows relevant to IR and detection. Hana, attach SOW addendum. Noah, confirm if customer wants a live bridge option.
deploy-bot: File created: sales/poc-packages/fintech-ir-kit (internal)
Priya (Security): I'll upload the CAIQ excerpt to the shared folder and link here after I scrub org-specific names.
Noah (AE): ETA for package?
Abe (Legal): Ill have draft clause + sample email by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Security): CAIQ snippets + suggested severity definitions by EOD today.
Hana (Solutions): SOW addendum by EOD today.
Noah (AE): Great, thanks all. I'll queue a follow-up with the customer once we have the package. :thumbsup:
